g.title: G
g.text: dev-kit v1.12 — flow, dependencies, parallelism and controls

g.title: cluster_plan
g.text: 1 · Specification (sequential, one agent at a time)

g.title: cluster_build
g.text: 2 · For each milestone Mn (in order; Mn+1 starts only after the Mn gate passes)

g.title: cluster_obs
g.text: Anytime · issues and follow-up (issue writes; the others are read-only; all recorded in the log)

g.title: start
g.text: starts a session in the log)

g.title: interview
g.text: model/effort ladder, local preview, production deploy

g.title: auto
g.text: unattended parks what needs you and goes on

g.title: onboard
g.text: (nothing in the code, docs or history changes)

g.title: impl
g.text: next ready task: hotfix lane → cool-down lane → fixes → plan
tests first (/dev-kit:test for strategy and repairs)
full suite → 1 commit per task (project's commit style)

g.title: plan
g.text: tasks T-xxx with deps and files)

g.title: pull
g.text: queued issues fill the buffer (20% of planned tasks)
standard before intangible · the rest waits

g.title: par
g.text: deps done, files do NOT overlap (max N);
own port, database, PIDs per slot

g.title: verify
g.text: one at a time: merge worktree, suite,
diff review, commit (hooks run here only)

g.title: qa
g.text: picks auditors based on what changed
(existing projects: only the diff since the baseline;

g.title: aud
g.text: AUDITORS IN PARALLEL (read-only, one slot each)
heavy auditors (browsers, e2e): max nproc/3 at a time
round 2+: only failed dimensions, next model/effort step

g.title: score
g.text: low findings capped · same finding from two audits counts once
round 2+ delta: previous findings closed or open;

g.title: prev
g.text: local preview (optional, inside qa, before the gate)

g.title: cool
g.text: go into Mn+1 first, audited by its qa

g.title: ship
g.text: method external: the project's CI deploys, kit records)

g.title: relaud
g.text: fails → fix tasks → implement → release again

g.title: feedback
g.text: timestamped report + export for the author

g.title: board
g.text: live board in the browser: what needs you,

g.title: costs
g.text: estimated US$ per stage, agent, model

g.title: help
g.text: what to do next · how each skill works

g.title: issue
g.text: classifies: expedite (hotfix now, WIP 1, patch release)

g.title: tips
g.text: shown when a mechanism matters (each twice)

g.title: tlog
g.text: structured session log, no project data
(skills, agents, rounds, scores, pauses, costs, feedback)
